metadata.article: ARTICLE 2-1. ZONING DISTRICTS AND LOT AND BUILDING STANDARDS

faqs.a:
A.	Purpose. The purpose of the Industrial, General (IG) zoning district is to provide areas for a wide variety of industrial, manufacturing and heavy industries, heavy logistics centers, storage yards, and comparable uses and activities, as well as less intensive industries and supporting uses.
B.	Relationship to the Comprehensive Plan. The IG zoning district generally implements the "Industrial" land use category stated in the Comprehensive Plan.
C.	Lot and Building Standards. The standards for lots and buildings in the IG zoning district are set out in Table 2-1-6-4A, Industrial, General Lot and Building Standards.
D.	Cross-References. The cross-references in Table 2-1-6-4B, Cross-References for Industrial, General, are provided for the reader's convenience and are not necessarily exhaustive of applicable regulations.
(Ord. No. 4793, § 1, 3-21-2022; Ord. No. 4851, § 1, 7-10-2023)
